description: Run a SOQL query against the configured Salesforce org. Returns immediately with a job_id and status 'queued' (D0.3 deferred-completion shape) -- the dispatch returning is NOT the same as the job finishing. When the job completes, the result is ALWAYS written to the caller-supplied output_tsv_path, never returned inline, at any size. This plugin never executes Apex, so the 50,000-record Apex governor limit does not apply here; the actual Salesforce fact for this call path (the sf CLI -> jsforce REST client) is a 2,000-record REST query batch size with no vendor total ceiling, and jsforce's autoFetch already pages past that internally. The limit below is entirely our own policy. Defaults to 500 records to avoid exhausting API request limits and disk, and to discourage pulling all records for client-side filtering that a SOQL WHERE clause should do instead. To fetch more, pass acknowledge_default_limit_override=true together with an explicit row_limit (up to 1000) -- both are required together, and a row_limit above 1000 is refused rather than silently clamped. For pulls beyond 1000 records, use export_soql instead (same override mechanism, hard cap 50000). When the goal is validating that records exist or picking one to act on next, prefer selecting stable ID fields over email addresses or other PII-bearing fields -- the SOQL SELECT list decides what comes back, so a narrower query is both cheaper and lower-exposure.
embedding_description: Run a quick, everyday SOQL query against the operator's Salesforce org for accounts, contacts, or opportunities, landing the matching records in a small workspace TSV file -- never inline, at any size. Dispatches asynchronously, returning a job_id while the TSV writes in the background, usually fast. Defaults to 500 records. Prefer stable ID fields over PII fields.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch envelope: job_id (string) and status ('queued'). This is NOT the query result -- the TSV handle (path, columns, row_count, total_size, truncated) arrives separately when the job completes and is delivered as its own message.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This call only confirms the query was queued -- do not present job_id/status as the query result. Acknowledge the request is in flight; the TSV handle lands in a follow-up message when the job completes. Once delivered, confirm the write: the path, the row_count, and the field list. The file may contain potentially sensitive CRM content (data_sensitivity 0.3) -- name the path for downstream use but never inline its contents into context. If truncated is true, say so and point to export_soql or an acknowledged row_limit override for the rest.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Run a SOQL query against the configured Salesforce org and write the result to a workspace TSV file.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: sf.invalid_params: missing query/output_tsv_path, the path's parent directory does not exist, acknowledge_default_limit_override and row_limit were not given together, or row_limit exceeded the 1000 hard cap. sf.export_path_refused: output_tsv_path is not absolute, not a .tsv, or not contained under any operator-configured export_allowed_roots entry (an empty export_allowed_roots refuses every write by default). sf.malformed_query: the SOQL is invalid or references an unknown field. sf.auth_failed: the sf CLI has no live session for the registered org. sf.session_expired: rare under full CLI delegation (the CLI refreshes its own credential per invocation) -- indicates the org itself rejected an in-flight call. sf.permission_denied: the CLI's authenticated user lacks access. sf.rate_limited: the org's API request limit was exceeded.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: sf.invalid_params naming the override pair: pass BOTH acknowledge_default_limit_override=true and an explicit row_limit, or neither (for the 500-record default); a row_limit above 1000 must go through export_soql instead. sf.invalid_params with a missing-parent message: create the parent directory first. sf.export_path_refused: pass an ABSOLUTE path ending in .tsv under a configured workspace root; if export_allowed_roots is empty, add the operator's export directory to the salesforce_plugin config. sf.malformed_query: fix the SOQL syntax or field names (use describe_sobject to check). sf.rate_limited: retry after a short delay. sf.auth_failed/session_expired/permission_denied: ask the operator to re-establish the org session with: sf org login web.
